info.title: Raines Africa E-Commerce API
info.description: Comprehensive e-commerce API for Raines Africa platform. Features: Multi-vendor marketplace, Product variations, Layby payment plans, Seller registration, Advanced filtering, Elasticsearch integration, and Mobile app support.
